sources.display_name: Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping earthquake map evidence
sources.expected_freshness: on-demand activation and product delivery; coverage exists only where an authorised user requested Rapid Mapping
sources.attribution_guidance: Credit Copernicus Emergency Management Service Rapid Mapping and link the EMSR activation. Present only delivered feasible delineation or grading products as secondary map evidence associated with an already selected earthquake event.
limitations: This provider performs no event discovery. A Rapid Mapping activation is a response request and does not independently prove event identity or occurrence.
Only EMSR Rapid Mapping activations categorized as Earthquake can qualify; Risk and Recovery EMSN products are excluded.
Candidates require same-country, event-time-within-three-days, and centroid-within-100-km checks unless the activation and selected event share the exact normalized GDACS identifier.
Delineation and grading products apply to requested Areas of Interest and do not establish complete event extent, unmapped impacts, casualties, warnings, response status, or national totals.
A missing activation is a coverage gap, not evidence that no earthquake occurred.

sources.display_name: Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping tropical-cyclone map evidence
sources.expected_freshness: on-demand activation and product delivery; coverage exists only where an authorised user requested Rapid Mapping
sources.attribution_guidance: Credit Copernicus Emergency Management Service Rapid Mapping and link the EMSR activation. Present only delivered feasible delineation or grading products as secondary map evidence associated with an already selected tropical-cyclone event.
limitations: This provider performs no event discovery. A Rapid Mapping activation is a response request and does not independently prove event identity or occurrence.
Only EMSR Rapid Mapping activations categorized as Storm can qualify; Risk and Recovery EMSN products are excluded.
Because the CEMS Storm category also contains non-cyclonic storms, an exact normalized TC GDACS identifier shared with the selected event is mandatory.
The activation centroid and mapped Areas of Interest are not a storm track, forecast cone, wind field, warning boundary, or complete impact extent.
A missing activation is a coverage gap, not evidence that no tropical cyclone occurred.
